templates.name: الترجمة المتحركة
templates.description: جمل تظهر مع الصوت، وفوقها رسم متحرك يتغير مع كل مشهد.

templates.name: الزخرفة الهندسية
templates.description: كلمة مفتاحية في نجمة زخرفية بألوان الأحجار الكريمة. بلا صور.

templates.name: القصة المصورة
templates.description: قصة حوار للأطفال بشخصيات ثابتة (سالم ومريم والمعلمة نور): مشاهد مصورة، ثم النص الشرعي، ومعاني الكلمات، وسؤال.

templates.name: السبورة
templates.description: القصة نفسها في شكل درس على سبورة: صور مثبتة على السبورة ورسوم بالطباشير.

art_kinds.word: the keyword alone, very large. The default when nothing else fits.
art_kinds.meter_down: a battery-style gauge draining from full to almost empty; keyword is its title. For decline, weakness, neglect.
art_kinds.meter_up: the same gauge filling up; keyword is its title. For renewal, growth, recovery.
art_kinds.compare: two things side by side, the first shrinking and the second (a glowing heart) growing; keyword labels the first, detail labels the second, emoji is one emoji for the first.
art_kinds.medallions: one or two round medallions holding short words: keyword and optionally detail.
art_kinds.lock: a padlock closing; keyword is its label. For closing doors to harm, protecting oneself.
art_kinds.warning: a pulsing warning sign on dark red; keyword is its label. For dangers to avoid.
art_kinds.dua: raised hands with rising light. For supplication.
art_kinds.phones: a phone shaking with notifications. For distraction and screens.
art_kinds.image: a generated still photo with a slow zoom, described in image_prompt. Only when no other kind can show the scene.

salim.look: a cheerful 7-year-old boy with short black hair, a green t-shirt and blue trousers

maryam.look: a 6-year-old girl, his sister, in a pink hijab and a yellow dress

nour.look: their kind young teacher, a woman in a cream hijab and a teal cardigan
